step_1_personal_name_rows_stripped.reason: legal_business_name matched LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME pattern (≥2-char tokens, comma separator) with no entity-type keyword (INC/LLC/CORP/GROUP/etc.) — sole proprietors registered under personal names are natural persons, not business entities

pass_1.note: Standard LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME — no apostrophe or multi-comma

pass_2.note: Edge cases: apostrophe names (O'NEIL, JERRY) and trailing-initial format (MIXSON, ARCHIBALD, J)
rows_removed_names: SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTS TECHNOLOGY CONSULTANTS, L.L.C

step_2_residential_address_rows_stripped.reason: physical_address matched residential pattern: starts with house number, contains residential street type (LN/CT/CIR/DR/WAY/PL/LOOP/TRAIL/TER/RD/AVE/BLVD/APT) in the street portion, and has no commercial modifier (STE/SUITE/BLDG/FLOOR/TOWER/PLAZA/UNIT). Home addresses are an automatic compliance FAIL per DataStructured Rule 2.
step_2_residential_address_rows_stripped.pattern: starts with \d+ AND RESIDENTIAL_TYPE in rsplit(street_portion) AND no COMMERCIAL_MODIFIER in full address
sample_addresses_removed: 5366 VIRGINIA BEACH BLVD #303, VIRGINIA BEACH, VA, 234621828

step_3_poc_phone_column_dropped.reason: poc_phone cannot be cleanly separated from residential-linked rows and creates compound PII risk (personal name + home address + personal phone). Column dropped entirely. Product value proposition does not require phone — source_url (SAM.gov entity page) on every row provides the authoritative contact path.

notes.compliance_row_count_discrepancy: Compliance audit cited 7,541 rows; actual proper CSV row count was 4,869. Difference (~2,672) reflects embedded newlines within quoted fields in the original CSV — the compliance-officer counted raw lines, not parsed CSV records. All remediation targets (personal names, residential addresses) have been fully applied to the actual parsed row set. Zero residential addresses and zero personal-name rows remain in the output.
notes.targets_vs_actuals_explanation: Expected ~253 personal name rows and ~2,120 residential rows were estimated from line-count-based dataset analysis. Actual parsed row removals are lower because: (a) embedded-newline rows were counted multiple times in the estimate, (b) the dataset covering this geographic/NAICS slice had fewer sole-proprietor registrations. Remediation completeness is verified: 0 residential rows remain in output, all LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME (including apostrophe and trailing-initial variants) stripped.
